facts.fact: StackAdapt and Comscore announced a partnership to provide Brand Survey Lift Study capabilities for connected TV campaigns, published April 28, 2020.
facts.quote: Title: StackAdapt and Comscore partner to bring brand survey lift capabilities for Connected TV campaigns

facts.fact: Comscore Brand Survey Lift for CTV is a survey-based branding effectiveness solution that measures total branding impact of CTV campaigns and lift attribution by network, placement and creative.
facts.quote: Comscore Brand Survey Lift for CTV is a survey-based branding effectiveness solution that measures the total branding impact of CTV campaigns

facts.fact: The first Comscore CTV Brand Survey Lift study was conducted with a large financial services client of StackAdapt, per the vendors' announcement.
facts.quote: The first ever Comscore CTV Brand Survey Lift study was conducted with StackAdapt’s large financial services client

facts.fact: Comscore trades on NASDAQ under the ticker SCOR.
facts.quote: Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms.

facts.fact: According to Comscore's own description, its data footprint combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence.
facts.quote: With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights
